\]

Substituting the values:

- New Value (2019) = \(-224.6\)
- Old Value (2018) = \(-220.4\)

\[
\text{Percentage Change} = \left(\frac{-224.6 - (-220.4)}{-220.4}\right) \times 100
\]

Calculating the difference:

\(-224.6 - (-220.4) = -224.6 + 220.4 = -4.2\)

Now substitute into the percentage change formula:

\[
\text{Percentage Change} = \left(\frac{-4.2}{-220.4}\right) \times 100 \approx 1.90\%
\]

Therefore, the percentage change in net finance costs from 2018 to 2019 is approximately \(1.90\%\) (indicating an increase).

Final Answer: approximately 1.90%
